profile.headline: Software Engineer - Frontend at ESPN Fantasy

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Maintain and build new dashboards for client facing application, VitalSigns, built on Node and React
-Refactor VitalSigns codebase to a Single Page Application
-Implement Storybook library to VitalSigns project to provide a clear component library
-Add tests to automation service built with Nightwatch.js
-Apply Google Tag Manager to track events made on VitalSigns by users
-Enhanced codebase by transitioning code to functional components to take full advantage of React hooks
-QA stories, tested code, and log/fix defects
-Deploy thru Jenkins and AWS
-Work in an Agile environment

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Built the navigation bar and landing pages with HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, Liquid 
Navigate thru Shopify to add and maintain site code

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Built full-stack websites for clients using React.js, Express.js, Bootstrap, Sass, MongoDB

positions.title: Junior Associate (Marketing and Events Coordination)
positions.description:
- Supervise the planning and execution of Red Bull marketing activations at high profile entertainment and music events including movie premiers, private parties, award shows, concerts, and music festivals
- Identify and establish relationships with up and coming talent in the entertainment and music industries, and coordinate outreach to celebrities/opinion influencers by creating brand experiences and/or gifting Red Bull product and infrastructure
- Assist in identifying opportunities for product placement in film/television
- Work with managers and prop masters on implementation of product placement in said film/television
- Manage logistics for LA entertainment and music events including infrastructure and supply deliveries and staffing
- On-site point person for these events supervising the brand activation from start to finish
- Create specialized cocktails for each event based on needs and requests of the client
- Create internal recaps for Red Bull corporate that highlight our marketing activations at events
- Track monthly delivery of Red Bull to the LA office's contacts, which include high profile industry executives, celebrities, TV and movie sets, Hollywood agencies, and others
- Order, maintain, and track Red Bull infrastructure, event supplies, and Red Bull product at our on site warehouse

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
-Researching and identifying new events, opinion leaders and industry areas of opportunity in Entertainment, Music & Digital Media
-Administrative duties including assisting with daily outreach requests, marketing reports, press clippings and contact database management
-Scanning social media, press outlets and TV & film for product placement
-Maintaining and keeping proper records of inventory including supplies, FedEx, product, etc.
-Assist with deliveries and event setup
-General office assistance with answering phones, covering reception desk and other office related duties
